$comment: Single source of truth for the Textarea API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Multi-line text with a label, a character count and optional auto-grow.
thumb:
BioA few words…
0 / 160

label.description: Visible label. Without it, pass an aria-label.

error.description: An error message. Also marks the textarea invalid.

maxLength.description: Limit, shown as a count under the field.

showCount.description: Show the count. On by default when maxLength is set.

autoResize.description: Grow with the text, up to 260px, then scroll.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A textarea with the Input classes plus vin-textarea, a label and a hint.

examples.title: Character count
examples.description: Set maxLength and the count appears. It turns red when the limit is reached. In HTML, add data-vin-textarea with the count's id and include vinui.js.

examples.title: Auto-grow
examples.description: Grows as you type instead of showing a scrollbar, then scrolls after 260px. Pure CSS in modern browsers, with a JavaScript fallback for the rest.

a11y: Every textarea has a label: a <label for> or an aria-label.
Hint, error and count are linked with aria-describedby, so they are read with the field.
The count is not a live region, so screen readers aren't interrupted on every key; it is read when the field gets focus.
An error sets aria-invalid="true" and is shown as text.
